Natsuki Subaru.prompt_ch: 一个普通的日本高中生，被召唤到异世界。他有黑色的短发，中等的身高和体格，穿着灰色的运动服和运动鞋。他的眼睛锐利。
Natsuki Subaru.prompt_en: An ordinary Japanese high school student who is summoned to a fantasy parallel world. He has short black hair, a medium height and build, and wears a gray tracksuit and sneakers. His eyes are sharp.

Emilia.prompt_ch: 一个半妖精少女，拥有强大的魔法能力。她有及腰的银色长发，蓝紫色的眼睛，穿着白色的长袍，上面绣着“似魔之鸟”的图腾，大约有一百六十公分左右。
Emilia.prompt_en: A half-elf girl with powerful magical abilities. She has waist-length silver hair, blue-purple eyes, and wears a white robe embroidered with a 'witch-like bird' emblem. She is approximately 160 cm tall.

Little Girl.prompt_ch: 一个迷路的小女孩，绿色的头发和眼睛，穿着破旧的衣服，脸上满是污垢，眼神迷茫，大约五六岁。
Little Girl.prompt_en: A lost little girl with green hair and eyes, wearing tattered clothes, her face covered in dirt, and a confused expression. She appears to be around five or six years old.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 菜月昴，一个普通的日本高中生，被召唤到了一个奇幻的异世界。他身无分文，对这个世界一无所知，只能靠着自己对动漫和游戏的了解来应对。
Plot Correspondence.en: Natsuki Subaru, an ordinary Japanese high school student, is summoned to a fantastical parallel world. Penniless and knowing nothing about this world, he relies on his knowledge of anime and games to navigate it.

Setting Description.ch: 白天，异世界的繁华街道，石板路，两旁是中世纪风格的建筑，摊贩林立，人来人往，热闹非凡，阳光明媚，空气中弥漫着各种食物的香气。
Setting Description.en: Daytime, a bustling street in the parallel world, cobblestone roads, medieval-style buildings on both sides, vendors lining the streets, crowds of people, vibrant atmosphere, bright sunlight, and the aroma of various foods in the air.

Static Shot Description.ch: 菜月昴站在街道中央，表情迷茫，四处张望，穿着灰色的运动服和运动鞋，与周围的环境格格不入。
Static Shot Description.en: Natsuki Subaru stands in the middle of the street, looking confused as he glances around, wearing a gray tracksuit and sneakers, standing out starkly against the surroundings.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 在这个异世界，他遇到了一群小混混，他们试图抢劫他。昴虽然勇敢地反抗了，但很快就被打得遍体鳞伤。
Plot Correspondence.en: In this parallel world, he encounters a group of thugs who attempt to rob him. Although Subaru bravely resists, he is quickly beaten to a pulp.

Setting Description.ch: 傍晚，异世界的小巷，阴暗潮湿，垃圾散落一地，墙上满是涂鸦，空气中弥漫着腐败的气味，光线昏暗。
Setting Description.en: Evening, a dark and damp alley in the parallel world, littered with garbage, graffiti-covered walls, a foul smell in the air, dim lighting.

Static Shot Description.ch: 菜月昴被三个小混混围在墙角，表情愤怒但无力，身上满是伤痕，小混混们表情狰狞，手中拿着棍棒。
Static Shot Description.en: Natsuki Subaru is cornered by three thugs against a wall, his expression angry but powerless, his body covered in bruises. The thugs look menacing, holding clubs.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 就在他以为自己的生命即将结束时，一个神秘的银发少女出现了。
Plot Correspondence.en: Just as he thinks his life is about to end, a mysterious silver-haired girl appears.

Setting Description.ch: 傍晚，异世界的小巷，阴暗潮湿，垃圾散落一地，墙上满是涂鸦，空气中弥漫着腐败的气味，光线昏暗，但巷口透进一丝亮光。
Setting Description.en: Evening, the same dark and damp alley, littered with garbage, graffiti-covered walls, foul smell in the air, dim lighting, but a faint light shines through the alley entrance.

Static Shot Description.ch: 爱蜜莉雅站在巷口，银发在微风中飘动，蓝紫色的眼睛冷冷地看着小混混们，表情平静但充满威严。
Static Shot Description.en: Emilia stands at the alley entrance, her silver hair fluttering slightly in the breeze, her blue-purple eyes coldly fixed on the thugs, her expression calm yet commanding.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 少女名叫爱蜜莉雅，她是一个半妖精，拥有强大的魔法能力。她救了昴，并决定帮助他找到被偷走的徽章。
Plot Correspondence.en: The girl introduces herself as Emilia, a half-elf with powerful magical abilities. She saves Subaru and decides to help him retrieve the stolen insignia.

Setting Description.ch: 傍晚，异世界的街道，石板路，两旁是中世纪风格的建筑，摊贩已经收摊，行人稀少，光线柔和。
Setting Description.en: Evening, the streets of the parallel world, cobblestone roads, medieval-style buildings on both sides, vendors packing up, few pedestrians, soft lighting.

Static Shot Description.ch: 爱蜜莉雅站在菜月昴面前，表情温和，帕克坐在她的肩膀上，菜月昴坐在地上，表情感激，身上的伤痕已经消失。
Static Shot Description.en: Emilia stands in front of Natsuki Subaru, her expression gentle, with Puck perched on her shoulder. Subaru sits on the ground, looking grateful, his wounds already healed.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 在寻找徽章的过程中，昴和爱蜜莉雅遇到了一个迷路的小女孩。爱蜜莉雅决定帮助她，尽管这可能会耽误他们寻找徽章的时间。
Plot Correspondence.en: While searching for the insignia, Subaru and Emilia encounter a lost little girl. Emilia decides to help her, even though it might delay their search for the insignia.

Setting Description.ch: 傍晚，异世界的广场，喷泉中央，周围是绿化带和长椅，行人三三两两，天空泛着橙红色的晚霞。
Setting Description.en: Evening, a plaza in the parallel world, a fountain at the center, surrounded by greenery and benches, a few pedestrians, the sky painted in orange-red twilight.

Static Shot Description.ch: 爱蜜莉雅蹲在小女孩面前，表情温柔，菜月昴站在一旁，表情有些焦急，小女孩表情迷茫，眼中含泪。
Static Shot Description.en: Emilia kneels in front of the little girl, her expression kind, while Subaru stands nearby, looking slightly impatient. The little girl appears lost, her eyes teary.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 昴也加入了帮助小女孩的行列，他用一个魔术让小女孩开心起来。
Plot Correspondence.en: Subaru joins in helping the little girl and uses a magic trick to cheer her up.

Setting Description.ch: 傍晚，异世界的广场，喷泉中央，周围是绿化带和长椅，行人三三两两，天空泛着橙红色的晚霞，喷泉的水珠在光线下闪烁。
Setting Description.en: Evening, the plaza in the parallel world, the fountain at the center, surrounded by greenery and benches, a few pedestrians, the sky painted in orange-red twilight, the fountain's water droplets glittering in the light.

Shot Perspective Design.en: Medium close up, eye level shot

Static Shot Description.ch: 菜月昴蹲在小女孩面前，表情专注，手中拿着一枚硬币，正在表演魔术，小女孩表情惊喜，眼中闪烁着光芒。
Static Shot Description.en: Natsuki Subaru kneels in front of the little girl, his expression focused as he performs a magic trick with a coin. The little girl looks delighted, her eyes sparkling with wonder.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 最终，他们找到了偷走徽章的小偷的藏身之处，一个被称为“赃物库”的地方。昴决定进去看看。
Plot Correspondence.en: Eventually, they locate the hideout of the thief who stole the insignia—a place called the 'Loot House.' Subaru decides to investigate.

Setting Description.ch: 夜晚，异世界的贫民区，破旧的房屋，街道狭窄，空气中弥漫着潮湿和霉味，月光透过云层洒下斑驳的光影。
Setting Description.en: Nighttime, the slums of the parallel world, dilapidated houses, narrow streets, a damp and musty smell in the air, moonlight casting patchy shadows through the clouds.

Static Shot Description.ch: 菜月昴站在一栋破旧的房屋前，表情坚定，房屋的门上挂着“赃物库”的牌子，周围一片寂静。
Static Shot Description.en: Natsuki Subaru stands in front of a rundown house, his expression resolute. A sign reading 'Loot House' hangs on the door, and the surroundings are eerily quiet.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 但当他进去后，他发现了一具尸体，然后被一个神秘的女人袭击了。
Plot Correspondence.en: But upon entering, he discovers a corpse and is then attacked by a mysterious woman.

Setting Description.ch: 夜晚，赃物库内部，昏暗的灯光，杂乱的货物堆放，空气中弥漫着灰尘和血腥味，一具尸体躺在角落。
Setting Description.en: Nighttime, inside the Loot House, dim lighting, cluttered with piled-up goods, dust and the scent of blood in the air, a corpse lying in the corner.

Static Shot Description.ch: 菜月昴表情震惊，眼中满是恐惧，看着角落的尸体，突然一个黑影从背后袭来，他猛地回头。
Static Shot Description.en: Natsuki Subaru looks shocked, his eyes filled with fear as he stares at the corpse in the corner. Suddenly, a shadowy figure attacks from behind, and he whirls around.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 昴受了重伤，生命垂危。就在他即将失去意识的时候，爱蜜莉雅冲了进来。
Plot Correspondence.en: Subaru is severely wounded and on the brink of death. Just as he is about to lose consciousness, Emilia bursts in.

Setting Description.ch: 夜晚，赃物库内部，昏暗的灯光，杂乱的货物堆放，空气中弥漫着灰尘和血腥味，地上满是血迹。
Setting Description.en: Nighttime, inside the Loot House, dim lighting, cluttered with piled-up goods, dust and the scent of blood in the air, bloodstains covering the floor.

Static Shot Description.ch: 菜月昴躺在地上，表情痛苦，身上满是伤痕，爱蜜莉雅冲进来，表情焦急，银发在空中飞舞。
Static Shot Description.en: Natsuki Subaru lies on the ground, his expression pained, his body covered in wounds. Emilia rushes in, her silver hair flowing as she looks frantic with worry.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 昴用尽最后的力气告诉她，他会救她。然后，他死了。
Plot Correspondence.en: With his last ounce of strength, Subaru tells her he will save her. Then, he dies.

Setting Description.ch: 夜晚，赃物库内部，昏暗的灯光，杂乱的货物堆放，空气中弥漫着灰尘和血腥味，地上满是血迹，月光透过窗户洒进来。
Setting Description.en: Nighttime, inside the Loot House, dim lighting, cluttered with piled-up goods, dust and the scent of blood in the air, bloodstains covering the floor, moonlight streaming through the window.

Static Shot Description.ch: 菜月昴的脸占据整个画面，表情虚弱但坚定，眼中满是决心，爱蜜莉雅的手轻轻握住他的手，眼中含泪。
Static Shot Description.en: Natsuki Subaru's face fills the screen, his expression weak but determined, his eyes full of resolve. Emilia gently holds his hand, her eyes brimming with tears.
